item.title: GIRLS BASKETBALL: Tamaqua Stuns North Schuylkill in Overtime
item.description: TAMAQUA — In a dramatic Schuylkill League Division 1 showdown Friday night, the Tamaqua Lady Raiders handed previously unbeaten North Schuylkill its first league loss with a thrilling 46–43 overtime victory. North Schuylkill entered the game 6–0 in league play and sitting atop Division 1, while Tamaqua came in right behind them at 5–1. item.title: One Injured After Vehicle Strikes Hoffman Memorial in Ashland
item.description: ASHLAND — One person was transported to the hospital Saturday evening following a motor vehicle crash that sent a vehicle into a local landmark in Ashland. The crash occurred around 4:45 p.m. at the intersection of Hoffman Boulevard and Spruce Street. According to Ashland Police, the driver of a vehicle lost control and struck the Hoffman Memorial.One occupant of the vehicle was taken to the hospital with injuries that were not immediately known.
